pin.estimand: Least-favourable mean token difference, Ainglish minus careful English, across three independently named tokenizer vocabularies on ten fresh accepted-but-not-enacted operational states; preserve the target original’s short-natural-baseline policy.
admissibility_gates: All ten frozen pairs must be different from the target original inputs.
All three declared tokenizers must execute; any skipped tokenizer or dead item aborts.
Each pair must preserve the same referent and both semantic facts: accepted/approved and not enacted/applied.
No item, tokenizer, or result cell may be removed after token counts are inspected.
Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable value and publish all per-tokenizer means.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts; item bytes fixed before tokenisation
manifest.prompts: none — no model is prompted; token counts only

population.description: Ten fresh operational states in which an approval or acceptance exists but enactment has not occurred.

estimand.baseline: The shortest natural careful-English sentence that explicitly preserves both acceptance and non-enactment.
estimand.aggregation: For each tokenizer, mean(tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english)) across all ten pairs; report the maximum mean as the least-favourable floor.

manifest.method: Fresh-item replication of manifest 4d4e9f6b9473920f946fa48ed9a3196bfc5334fdaa866b77fff14c45743aceeb. Every pair preserves the same referent and the same accepted-but-not-enacted fact. No pair is copied from the target. Run the Ainglish reference measure.py harness; report all three tokenizer means and the least-favourable maximum, with no item or tokenizer exclusions after inspection.
